summary: Serve typed source and control-register fences on native attention rows

rules.detail: No checkpoint or coordinated upgrade required.

compatibility.detail: Open attention rows include additive presentation_control metadata: semantic source revision, nullable register revision, dismissed state and nullable UTC snooze deadline. Rust, TypeScript and Swift client models accept the field; older daemon rows remain valid. Filtering and metadata read the same registers before building each visible row.

manual.detail: No action required. This change advertises no new mutation route.

recovery.detail: The additive serving field leaves source work and stored controls unchanged.
